prompt_md: You buy a bike for 60 dollars and sell it for 70. Then you buy it back for 80 and sell it again for 90. What's your total profit, in dollars?
prompt_short: Buy at 60, sell at 70, buy at 80, sell at 90. Profit?
hint_md: Treat it as two separate deals.
explain_intuition_md: Each deal makes 10 dollars on its own: 60 to 70, then 80 to 90. Buying back at 80 feels like losing 10, but that money was never yours to lose.
